verdict.rationale: Mailchimp ships its own generative AI features, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents that ability. The 'AI you already use… without leaving the chat' claim describes external AIs using Mailchimp, which is the server role, not Mailchimp consuming MCP tools as a client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
